```{r setup}
params <- list(

  pathway_fdr_threshold = 0.05,

  run_gsea              = TRUE,

  table_dir             = "../results/tables_slc6a8_continuous/",

  se_rds                = "../results/rds/se_tcga.rds",
  fig_dir               = "../results/figures_slc6a8_continuous/",
  msigdb_dir            = "../../references/MSigDb_2025.1/"
)

# Load packages ----------------------------------------------------------------

# Load functions ---------------------------------------------------------------

# Load globals -----------------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(params$seed)

if(!dir.exists(params$rds_dir)) dir.create(params$rds_dir, recursive = TRUE)
if(!dir.exists(params$fig_dir)) dir.create(params$fig_dir, recursive = TRUE)
if(!dir.exists(params$table_dir)) dir.create(params$table_dir, recursive = TRUE)

de_table_cols <- c(
  "GENEID", "Symbol", "logFC", "logCPM", "F", "PValue", "FDR"
)

round_de_table_cols <- c(
  "logFC", "logCPM", "F", "PValue", "FDR"
)

shiny_path <- file.path(
  params$rds_dir, "shiny", "rds"
)

msigdb_dir <- "../../references/MSigDb_2025.1/"
```

# Load data

```{r load-data}
se <- readRDS(params$se_rds)

gnes <- as.data.frame(rowData(se))
gnes <- gnes %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    GENEID = gene_id,
    Symbol = gene_name,
    SYMBOL = gene_name,
    DESCRIPTION = NA_character_,
    gene_type = gene_type
  )
rownames(gnes) <- gnes$GENEID

library(org.Hs.eg.db)
desc_map <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys      = gnes$GENEID,
  column    = "GENENAME",
  keytype   = "ENSEMBL",
  multiVals = "first"
)

gnes$DESCRIPTION <- unname(desc_map[gnes$GENEID])

cat("Gene types breakdown (pre-filter):\n")
print(table(gnes$gene_type))

pc_genes <- gnes$GENEID[gnes$gene_type == "protein_coding"]
cat(sprintf("Restricting from %d to %d protein-coding genes\n",
            nrow(gnes), length(pc_genes)))

se <- se[pc_genes, ]
gnes <- gnes[pc_genes, ]

meta_clinic <- as.data.frame(colData(se))

cnts_aml <- assay(se, "unstranded")
storage.mode(cnts_aml) <- "integer"

grp <- data.frame(
  OriginalSampleName = colnames(cnts_aml),
  Condition = rep("AML", ncol(cnts_aml)),
  colData(se)
)

dge <- DGEList(counts = cnts_aml,
                samples = grp,
                genes = gnes)
rownames(dge$genes) <- rownames(gnes)
rownames(dge) <- rownames(gnes)

tpm_aml <- assay(se, "tpm_unstranded")

gene_sets <- readRDS(file.path(params$msigdb_dir, "msigdb_v2025.1.Hs_gene_sets.rds"))
```

# Extract SLC6A8 expression

```{r}
pseudo_idx <- which(dge$genes$GENEID == "ENSG00000268982")
if (length(pseudo_idx) > 0) {
  dge <- dge[-pseudo_idx, ]
}
```

```{r}
gene_col <- "GENEID"
gene <- c("ENSG00000130821")
ridx <- which(dge$genes[[gene_col]] %in% gene)
stopifnot(length(ridx) == 1)

slc6a8_expr <- list()
slc6a8_expr$raw <- dge$counts[ridx, ]

slc6a8_geneid <- rownames(dge)[dge$genes$GENEID == "ENSG00000130821"]
slc6a8_expr$norm <- edgeR::cpm(dge, log = TRUE, prior.count = 2)[slc6a8_geneid, ]
slc6a8_expr$norm_tpm <- tpm_aml[rownames(dge$genes)[ridx], ]
```

# Check potential confounders

```{r}
covariate <- meta_clinic[, c("FLT3_ITD", "FLT3_TKD", "NPM1", "RUNX1", "ASXL1", "TP53",
                              "BM_BLAST_PERCENTAGE", "gender", "age_at_diagnosis",
                              "cyto_risk_group", "fab_category")]
covariate$id <- rownames(covariate)

for (v in c("FLT3_ITD", "FLT3_TKD", "NPM1", "RUNX1", "ASXL1", "TP53")) {
  covariate[[v]] <- factor(ifelse(covariate[[v]] == 1, "positive", "negative"),
                            levels = c("negative", "positive"))
}
covariate$gender <- factor(covariate$gender)
covariate$cyto_risk_group <- factor(covariate$cyto_risk_group)
covariate$fab_category <- factor(covariate$fab_category)

covariate <- covariate[match(names(slc6a8_expr$raw), covariate$id), ]
```

```{r}
na_placeholders <- c("not available", "not classified")

recode_na_placeholders <- function(x, placeholders = na_placeholders) {
  is_fac <- is.factor(x)
  x_chr  <- as.character(x)
  stripped <- tolower(trimws(gsub("[][]", "", x_chr)))
  hit <- stripped %in% placeholders
  x_chr[hit] <- NA
  if (is_fac) factor(x_chr) else x_chr
}

target_cols <- c("cyto_risk_group", "fab_category")

covariate[target_cols]   <- lapply(covariate[target_cols],   recode_na_placeholders)
dge$samples[target_cols] <- lapply(dge$samples[target_cols], recode_na_placeholders)

covariate$BM_BLAST_PERCENTAGE <- as.numeric(covariate$BM_BLAST_PERCENTAGE)
covariate$age_at_diagnosis <- as.numeric(covariate$age_at_diagnosis)
dge$samples$BM_BLAST_PERCENTAGE <- as.numeric(dge$samples$BM_BLAST_PERCENTAGE )
dge$samples$age_at_diagnosis <- as.numeric(dge$samples$age_at_diagnosis)
```

```{r }
ASSAY <- "norm"
covariate$slc6a8 <- slc6a8_expr[[ASSAY]][covariate$id]

na_summary <- sort(colMeans(is.na(covariate)) * 100, decreasing = TRUE)
cat("Percentage NA values:")
print(round(na_summary[na_summary > 0], 1))

cont_vars <- c("age_at_diagnosis", "BM_BLAST_PERCENTAGE")
cat_vars  <- c("FLT3_ITD", "FLT3_TKD", "NPM1", "RUNX1", "ASXL1", "TP53",
               "gender", "cyto_risk_group", "fab_category")

cont_titles <- c(
  age_at_diagnosis    = "Age at diagnosis",
  BM_BLAST_PERCENTAGE = "% BM blasts"
)
cat_titles <- c(
  FLT3_ITD        = "FLT3-ITD",
  FLT3_TKD        = "FLT3-TKD",
  NPM1            = "NPM1",
  RUNX1           = "RUNX1",
  ASXL1           = "ASXL1",
  TP53            = "TP53",
  gender          = "Sex",
  cyto_risk_group = "Cytogenetic risk group",
  fab_category    = "FAB category"
)

cor_tests <- lapply(cont_vars, function(v) {
  cor.test(covariate$slc6a8, covariate[[v]], method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
})
names(cor_tests) <- cont_vars

cor_estimates <- sapply(cor_tests, function(ct) unname(ct$estimate))
cor_pvals     <- sapply(cor_tests, function(ct) ct$p.value)

cat("Continuous covariates; Spearman rho with SLC6A8:\n")
print(round(sort(abs(cor_estimates), decreasing = TRUE), 3))
cat("Continuous covariates; Spearman p-value with SLC6A8:\n")
print(signif(sort(cor_pvals), 3))

kw_results <- sapply(cat_vars, function(v) {
  grp <- covariate[[v]]
  if (length(unique(na.omit(grp))) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  kruskal.test(covariate$slc6a8 ~ grp)$p.value
})
cat("Categorical covariates; Kruskal-Wallis p-value:\n")
print(signif(sort(kw_results), 3))

format_pval_sci <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return(NA_character_)
  sprintf("p = %.2e", p)
}
```

# Filtering

```{r}
stopifnot(all(colnames(dge) == covariate$id))

dge$samples$slc6a8_raw  <- slc6a8_expr$raw[colnames(dge)]
dge$samples$slc6a8_norm <- slc6a8_expr$norm[colnames(dge)]

dge$samples$slc6a8_log2 <- log2(dge$samples$slc6a8_raw + 1)

stopifnot(all(rownames(dge$samples) == rownames(covariate)))
dge$samples$FLT3_ITD    <- covariate$FLT3_ITD
dge$samples$NPM1        <- covariate$NPM1
dge$samples$BM_BLAST_PERCENTAGE <- covariate$BM_BLAST_PERCENTAGE
dge$samples$gender      <- covariate$gender
dge$samples$cyto_risk_group <- covariate$cyto_risk_group
dge$samples$fab_category    <- covariate$fab_category
dge$samples$age         <- covariate$age_at_diagnosis

dge <- calcNormFactors(dge, method = "TMM")

keep <- filterByExpr(dge, min.count = 10, min.total.count = 15)
dge_filt <- dge[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
cat(sprintf("Genes retained: %d / %d\n", sum(keep), length(keep)))
```

```{r}
na_mask <- complete.cases(dge_filt$samples[, c(
  "slc6a8_norm", "FLT3_ITD", "NPM1","BM_BLAST_PERCENTAGE"
)])
cat(sprintf("Samples dropped due to NA: %d\n", sum(!na_mask)))

if(all(na_mask)){
  dge_red <- dge_filt
} else {
  dge_red <- dge_filt[, na_mask, keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
}
s <- dge_red$samples
cat(sprintf("Final n = %d samples, %d genes\n", ncol(dge_red), nrow(dge_red)))
```

## PCA {.tabset}

```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=9, results='asis'}
top_var  <- order(rowVars(logcpm), decreasing = TRUE)[1:2000]
pca      <- prcomp(t(logcpm[top_var, ]), scale. = FALSE, center = TRUE)
pct_var  <- round(100 * summary(pca)$importance[2, 1:4], 1)

pca_df <- data.frame(
  PC1     = pca$x[, 1],
  PC2     = pca$x[, 2],
  PC3     = pca$x[, 3],
  sample  = rownames(s),
  slc6a8  = slc6a8_expr$norm,
  FLT3_ITD = s$FLT3_ITD,
  NPM1    = s$NPM1,
  BM_BLAST_PERCENTAGE = s$BM_BLAST_PERCENTAGE,
  cyto_risk_group = s$cyto_risk_group,
  fab_category = s$fab_category
)

for (VAR in colnames(pca_df[, -c(1:4)])){

  cat("###", VAR, "\n\n")

  p_pca <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, colour = .data[[VAR]])) +
    geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(
      colour = VAR,
       x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", pct_var[1]),
       y = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", pct_var[2])
    )
  if (VAR %in% c("slc6a8", "BM_BLAST_PERCENTAGE")) {
    p_pca <- p_pca + scale_colour_gradient2(
      low = "#4E79A7", mid = "grey", high = "#E15759",
      midpoint = median(pca_df[[VAR]], na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  } else {
    p_pca <- p_pca + scale_colour_discrete(na.translate = FALSE)
  }

  p_pca2 <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC2, y = PC3, colour = .data[[VAR]])) +
    geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(
      colour = VAR,
       x = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", pct_var[2]),
       y = sprintf("PC3 (%.1f%%)", pct_var[3])
    )
  if (VAR %in% c("slc6a8", "BM_BLAST_PERCENTAGE")) {
    p_pca2 <- p_pca2 + scale_colour_gradient2(
      low = "#4E79A7", mid = "grey", high = "#E15759",
      midpoint = median(pca_df[[VAR]], na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  } else {
    p_pca2 <- p_pca2 + scale_colour_discrete(na.translate = FALSE)
  }

  print(p_pca + p_pca2)
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

## Pairwise correlation

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=8}
set.seed(42)
idx_cor  <- sample(nrow(logcpm), min(3000, nrow(logcpm)))
cor_mat  <- cor(logcpm[idx_cor, ], method = "spearman")

ann_col <- data.frame(
  SLC6A8  = slc6a8_expr$norm,
  FLT3    = s$FLT3_ITD,
  NPM1    = s$NPM1,
  row.names = colnames(cor_mat)
)

ann_colors <- list(
  SLC6A8 = slc6a8_pal,
  FLT3   = c(positive = "#E15759", negative = "#A0CBE8"),

)

pheatmap(

  color             = colorRampPalette(c("#4E79A7", "white", "#E15759"))(100),
```

# Differential Expression

## Design matrix

```{r }
design <- model.matrix(
  ~ slc6a8_norm + FLT3_ITD + NPM1 + BM_BLAST_PERCENTAGE,
  data = s
)

cat("Design matrix dimensions:", dim(design), "\n")
cat("Coefficient of interest: 'slc6a8_norm' (log2 and library size CPM normalized counts)\n")
cat("All coefficients:\n"); print(colnames(design))
```

## QC

### Voom plot

```{r}
v <- voom(dge_red, design, plot = TRUE)
```

## Mean-variance trend after correction

```{r}
fit  <- lmFit(v, design)
fit  <- eBayes(fit, trend = TRUE, robust = TRUE)

plotSA(fit, main = "Mean-variance trend after eBayes — TCGA-LAML")
```

## Results summary

```{r}
fdr_thr  <- 0.05
lfc_thr  <- 1

res <- topTable(
  fit,
   coef      = "slc6a8_norm",
  number     = Inf,
  adjust.method = "BH",
  sort.by    = "P"
)

res$SYMBOL <- ifelse(is.na(res$SYMBOL) | res$SYMBOL == "",
                     rownames(res), res$SYMBOL)
res$neg_log10_p <- -log10(res$P.Value)
res$neg_log10_fdr <- -log10(res$adj.P.Val)

res$direction <- case_when(
  res$adj.P.Val < fdr_thr & res$logFC >  0 ~ "up",
  res$adj.P.Val < fdr_thr & res$logFC < 0 ~ "down",
  TRUE                                             ~ "ns"
)
res$direction <- factor(res$direction, levels = c("up", "down", "ns"))

diffexp_gene_table <-   res |>
    dplyr::filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05) |>
    mutate(Direction = case_when(
      logFC > 0 ~ "Up",
      TRUE ~ "Down"
    )) |>
    summarise(N = n(), .by = Direction) |>
    mutate(Contrast = "SLC6A8") |>
  pivot_wider(id_cols = Contrast, names_from = Direction, values_from = N)

kable(diffexp_gene_table)
```

## Log-fold change interpretation

```{r}
iqr_slc6a8 <- IQR(dge_red$samples$slc6a8_norm)

res$logFC_per_IQR <- res$logFC * iqr_slc6a8
res$raw_logFC = res$logFC
res$logFC = res$logFC_per_IQR
```

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height=10}
iqr_slc6a8_norm   <- IQR(dge_red$samples$slc6a8_norm)
lfc_thr_raw       <- 1 / iqr_slc6a8_norm

res$direction <- case_when(
  res$adj.P.Val < fdr_thr & res$logFC_per_IQR >  1 ~ "up",
  res$adj.P.Val < fdr_thr & res$logFC_per_IQR < -1 ~ "down",
  TRUE                                              ~ "ns"
)
res$direction <- factor(res$direction, levels = c("up", "down", "ns"))

plot_df <- data.frame(
  logFC         = res$raw_logFC,
  logFC_per_IQR = res$logFC_per_IQR,
  direction     = res$direction,
  SYMBOL        = res$SYMBOL,
  adj.P.Val     = res$adj.P.Val
)

genes_highlight <- c("SLC6A8")
top_lab <- bind_rows(
  plot_df |> filter(direction == "up")   |> slice_max(logFC_per_IQR, n = 1),
  plot_df |> filter(direction == "down")  |> slice_min(logFC_per_IQR, n = 1),
  plot_df |> filter(SYMBOL %in% genes_highlight)
) |> distinct()

dir_cols <- c(up = "#E15759", down = "#4E79A7", ns = "grey80")

p_main <- ggplot(plot_df,
                 aes(x = logFC, y = logFC_per_IQR, colour = direction)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.7, alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_point(data = top_lab, size = 3.1, alpha = 1) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data         = top_lab,
    aes(label    = SYMBOL),
    size         = 3.8,
    max.overlaps = 30,
    segment.size = 0.3,
    colour       = "black"
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2),
             linetype   = "dashed", linewidth = 0.35, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2) / iqr_slc6a8_norm,
             linetype   = "dashed", linewidth = 0.35, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-1, 1),
             linetype = "solid", linewidth = 0.5, colour = "grey20") +
  annotate("text",
           x = 1 / iqr_slc6a8_norm, y = max(plot_df$logFC_per_IQR) * 0.3,
           label = sprintf("raw logFC = %.3f\n→ IQR logFC = 1 (2-fold)",
                           1 / iqr_slc6a8_norm),
           hjust = -0.05, size = 4.8, colour = "#E15759") +
  annotate("text",
           x = -1 / iqr_slc6a8_norm, y = min(plot_df$logFC_per_IQR) * 0.3,
           label = sprintf("raw logFC = %.3f\n→ IQR logFC = −1 (½-fold)",
                           -1 / iqr_slc6a8_norm),
           hjust = 1.05, size = 4.8, colour = "#4E79A7") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = dir_cols, name = NULL) +
  labs(
    title    = "Raw logFC vs. IQR-scaled logFC",
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "y = x × IQR  |  IQR of SLC6A8 (CQN log2) = %.2f log2 units  |  slope = %.2f",
      iqr_slc6a8_norm, iqr_slc6a8_norm),
    x = "Raw logFC \n(per 1 log2 unit increase in SLC6A8)",
    y = sprintf("logFC per IQR \n(per %.2f log2 unit increase in SLC6A8)",
                iqr_slc6a8_norm)
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

p_raw_dens <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = logFC, fill = direction)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 80, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 0, 1) / iqr_slc6a8_norm,
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4, colour = "grey40") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = dir_cols, name = NULL) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of raw logFC",
       subtitle = "Dashed lines = raw equivalents of IQR logFC −1, 0, +1",
       x = "Raw logFC", y = "Gene count") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p_iqr_dens <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = logFC_per_IQR, fill = direction)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 80, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2),
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6, colour = "grey40") +
  annotate("text", x = c(-2, -1, 1, 2),
           y = Inf, vjust = 2, size = 4.6,
           label = c("4-fold\nlower", "2-fold\nlower",
                     "2-fold\nhigher", "4-fold\nhigher")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = dir_cols, name = NULL) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of IQR-scaled logFC",
       subtitle = "Dashed lines at interpretable fold-change",
       x = sprintf("logFC per IQR (%.2f log2 units)", iqr_slc6a8_norm),
       y = "Gene count") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

(p_main) /
(p_raw_dens + p_iqr_dens) +
  plot_annotation(
    title   = "Relationship between raw and IQR-scaled logFC",
    caption = sprintf(
      "IQR = %.2f log2 units | raw logFC threshold = %.3f | n = %d genes | Significant (FDR < 0.05, |logFC/IQR| > 1): %d",
      iqr_slc6a8_norm, lfc_thr_raw, nrow(plot_df), sum(plot_df$direction != "ns")
    )
  )
```

# Pathway enrichment analysis

```{r}
ranked_list <- res$t
names(ranked_list) <- res$GENEID
ranked_list <- sort(ranked_list, decreasing = TRUE)

ranked_list <- ranked_list[!is.na(ranked_list)]
ranked_list <- ranked_list[!duplicated(names(ranked_list))]

ranked_list <- ranked_list[-which(names(ranked_list) == gene)]

collections_keep <- c(
  "H", "C2:CGP", "C2:CP:KEGG_LEGACY", "C2:CP:REACTOME",
  "C2:CP:WIKIPATHWAYS", "C5:GO:BP", "C7:IMMUNESIGDB"
)

gene_sets_filt <- gene_sets[gene_sets$collection_name %in% collections_keep, ]

term2gene <- gene_sets_filt |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tidyr::unnest(cols = ensembl) |>
  dplyr::select(gs_name = geneset_name, ensembl_gene = ensembl) |>
  dplyr::filter(ensembl_gene %in% names(ranked_list)) |>
  as.data.frame()

term2name <- gene_sets_filt |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  dplyr::select(gs_name = geneset_name, description_brief) |>
  dplyr::distinct() |>
  as.data.frame()
```

```{r}
gsea_res_txt <- file.path(params$table_dir, "gsea_all.txt")
if(!file.exists(gsea_res_txt)){

  set.seed(42)

  gsea_res <- GSEA(
    geneList     = ranked_list,
    TERM2GENE    = term2gene,
    TERM2NAME    = term2name,
    eps          = 0,
    minGSSize    = 15,
    maxGSSize    = 500,
    pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
    verbose      = FALSE
  )
  saveRDS(gsea_res, file = file.path(params$rds_dir, "gsea_output.rds"))

  gsea_res <- gsea_res %>% as.data.frame()

  gsea_res$collection_name <- gene_sets_filt$collection_name[match(gsea_res$ID, gene_sets_filt$geneset_name)]
  gsea_res$Ngenes <- lengths(strsplit(gsea_res$core_enrichment, "/", fixed = TRUE))
  gsea_res$fractionOverlap <- gsea_res$Ngenes/ gsea_res$setSize
  core_enrichment <- data.frame("ID" = gsea_res$ID, "core_enrichment" =  gsea_res$core_enrichment)
  gsea_res$core_enrichment <- NULL
  gsea_res$leading_edge <- NULL

  write.table(gsea_res, file.path(params$table_dir, "gsea_all.txt"), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
  write_xlsx(gsea_res, file.path(params$table_dir, "gsea_all.xlsx"))
  write_xlsx(gsea_res |> dplyr::filter(p.adjust < 0.05), file.path(params$table_dir, "gsea_sig.xlsx"))
  write.table(core_enrichment, file.path(params$table_dir, "gsea_core_enrichment.txt"), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

} else {

  gsea_res <- fread(gsea_res_txt) %>% as.data.frame()
  rownames(gsea_res) <- gsea_res$ID

  core_enrichment <- fread(file.path(params$table_dir, "gsea_core_enrichment.txt")) %>% as.data.frame()
}
```
